prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a collision that occurred in a parking lot. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in touch with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other policies that may apply to this loss.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, telematics or dash camera data, and any surveillance footage from the parking lot. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the requested information.
